tokens.name: background
tokens.usage: Apple systemBackground. Page ground for story pages, Index, Now and the ⌘K panel.

tokens.name: secondary-background
tokens.usage: Apple secondarySystemBackground. Grouped or recessed areas: the phone caption panel, quiet panels.

tokens.name: label
tokens.usage: Apple label. Titles, body copy, nav links, the selected 2D/3D pill. 4.5:1+ on `background` and `hall-wall` in every theme.

tokens.name: secondary-label
tokens.usage: Apple secondaryLabel. Meta lines, ledes on the wall, numbers, timeline labels, footer. Light uses apple.com's #6e6e73 because the iOS value (60,60,67 at 60%) is only 3.4:1 on white; dark uses the iOS value (6.4:1 on black).

tokens.name: tertiary-label
tokens.usage: Apple tertiaryLabel. Marks only, never words: far doors, dashed placeholder borders. Below AA for text by design.

tokens.name: separator
tokens.usage: Apple separator. Hairlines: pill borders, dividers, the ⌘K panel outline.

tokens.name: fill
tokens.usage: Apple systemFill. The selected row in ⌘K and other quiet fills.

tokens.name: hall-wall
tokens.usage: The hall's wall and the fill of header pills. Concrete lays the wall texture over it; Sky makes it clear so the sky shows.

tokens.name: hall-floor
tokens.usage: The hall's floor. Concrete adds the floor texture; Sky shows grass. Keep text off the Concrete and Sky floor.

tokens.name: door-leaf
tokens.usage: The door panel that swings open (Apple systemGray6 light, systemGray5 dark).

tokens.name: door-edge
tokens.usage: Door edges and the room's outer falloff (Apple systemGray4).

tokens.name: room-light
tokens.usage: The warm light inside a room behind a door.

tokens.name: room-light-core
tokens.usage: The brightest spot of a room's light.

tokens.name: runner
tokens.usage: The runner's body. Concrete and Sky make him glow red.

tokens.name: device-bezel
tokens.usage: Phone and laptop bezels. The same in every theme.

tokens.name: device-edge
tokens.usage: The highlight edge on bezels.

tokens.name: device-screen
tokens.usage: An empty screen before media loads.

tokens.name: placeholder-bg
tokens.usage: Temporary. Highlight behind copy Suraj still has to write.

tokens.name: placeholder-ink
tokens.usage: Temporary. Text on `placeholder-bg` (7.7:1 light, 8.9:1 dark).

tokens.name: note-bg
tokens.usage: Temporary. The blue working note on story pages.

tokens.name: note-ink
tokens.usage: Temporary. Text on `note-bg` (10:1+).

styles.name: title-xl
styles.usage: Story page titles (h1). Shrinks to 40px on narrow screens.

styles.name: title-l
styles.usage: Every title on the wall, with or without a door.

styles.name: title-m
styles.sample: I design products and build them, from zero to one.
styles.usage: The hall's intro and closing statements, the phone caption title, section labels on story pages.

styles.name: text-l
styles.usage: Ledes under story titles and the meta line above them.

styles.name: text-m
styles.sample: Quitting isn’t linear, so the small states mattered as much as the happy path.
styles.usage: Story body copy, and the outcome line and links on wall labels.

styles.name: text-s
styles.usage: Everything else: nav, buttons, meta on the wall, footer. The floor: nothing is smaller.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Pills: the 2D/3D switch and its buttons, the ⌘K button.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: The ⌘K search panel.

tokens.name: radius-tile
tokens.usage: Company marks on the timeline.

tokens.name: radius-tag
tokens.usage: Placeholder highlights (`placeholder-bg`).

tokens.name: shadow-panel
tokens.usage: The ⌘K panel, together with a 1px `separator` outline.
